method: Visual inspection of final contact sheet, labeled direction sheet, motion stills, and native idle/jump cells; structural reports were not used as visual evidence.

findings.clipping: No visible horn, wing, tail, hair, or foot clipping in occupied cells; blank unused cells are intentional.
findings.attachments: Wings and tail remain connected to each complete character. No detached effects visible.
findings.identity: White hair, pale horns, lavender wings/tail/dress and same-side hair accessory remain recognizable across all rows. Review row retains its same chin hand.
findings.scale: Grounded states show comparable apparent scale after normalization. Jump anticipation is crouched, peak retains plausible head/body proportions and rises visibly; no extreme enlargement or shrinkage apparent.
findings.cardinals: 000 shows a raised face and upward gaze; 090 turns the face toward screen-right; 180 bows the face with lowered gaze/closed lids; 270 turns face and gaze toward screen-left. Body and feet remain essentially front-anchored rather than whole-character turntable.
findings.quadrants: Intermediate poses follow up-right, down-right, down-left, up-left families in order; no obvious wrong-quadrant reversal.
findings.boundary_157_5_to_180: The down-right bowed face transitions to a centered bowed face; matching whole-character scale and baseline, no visible row seam jump.
findings.boundary_337_5_to_000: The raised up-left face transitions to a centered raised face; scale and baseline appear continuous, no visible row seam jump.

limitations: Review uses still sequences and native frame images, not timed playback; temporal cadence is not assessed here.
Fine details are subdued at pet size, but overall silhouette and gaze landmarks remain readable.
